facts.fact: IMD declared that the southwest monsoon withdrew from the entire country on 15 October 2026
facts.was: as of IMD's 14 Oct 2026 release the monsoon had not yet withdrawn from the whole country (withdrawal line through 27.0N/90.5E, Dhubri, Kolkata, Angul, Khammam, Honavar, 14.0N/73.0E); no declaration yet
facts.quote: The Southwest monsoon was withdrawn from the entire country on 15th October, 2026.
facts.note: IMD's press-release list (internal.imd.gov.in/pages/press_release_mausam.php) also lists release no. 5405 of 15 Oct 2026: 'SOUTHWEST MONSOON HAS WITHDRAWN FROM THE ENTIRE COUNTRY TODAY' (its PDF link returns 404).

facts.fact: On the same day, 15 October 2026, northeast monsoon rainfall began over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Karaikal, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Rayalaseema, South Interior Karnataka and Kerala & Mahe
facts.was: conditions were becoming favourable for northeast monsoon rains to start over the south peninsula on 15 Oct 2026
facts.quote: Simultaneously, the Northeast monsoon rainfall activity commenced over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Karaikal, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Rayalaseema, South Interior Karnataka, and Kerala & Mahe on 15th October.

behaviour: Answers from the dated IMD release (mausam.imd.gov.in): the southwest monsoon withdrew from the entire country on 15 October 2026; states the source and its date; does not use dates from earlier years.
fail_if: Gives a date taken from a previous year (e.g., 15 Oct 2025 or 28 Oct 2020); says the monsoon has not yet withdrawn from the whole country; gives a 2026 withdrawal date other than 15 October; cites news, Facebook or Hindustan Times.
summary: IMD's 22 Oct 2026 ERF release states the SW monsoon withdrew from the entire country on 15 Oct 2026; the 'not yet withdrawn' answer is replaced with that date.
